# monotaur_sensor (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur sensor. Sensors collect data for a probe using a named plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_monitor" "api_health" {
  name = "API Health Check"
  type = "Heartbeat"
}

resource "monotaur_probe" "http" {
  monitor_id = monotaur_monitor.api_health.id
  active     = true
  schedule   = "*/5 * * * *"
}

resource "monotaur_sensor" "http_check" {
  probe_id    = monotaur_probe.http.id
  name        = "HTTP Check"
  plugin_name = "NetSensors"
  type        = "HttpSensor"
  parameters  = jsonencode({ Url = "https://api.example.com/health" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the sensor.
- `plugin_name` (String) The name of the plugin that powers this sensor.
- `probe_id` (String) The ID of the probe this sensor belongs to.
- `type` (String) The type identifier of the sensor.

### Optional

- `parameters` (String) JSON-encoded parameters for the sensor plugin, validated by the server against the sensor type's parameters schema (see `GET /api/v1/plugins`). Use `jsonencode()`, e.g. `jsonencode({ Url = "https://example.com/health" })` for a `NetSensors` `HttpSensor`. Keys are case-sensitive. Formatting and key order are preserved when the server's value is semantically equal.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the sensor was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the sensor (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the sensor was last updated (assigned by the API).
